A '''force escort''' or '''escort force''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[systems admiral]]. It was comprised of two [[heavy squadron]]s, and two [[light squadron]]s, for a total average of one hundred and eight [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Force escort formations were deployed to protect commercially strategic space or installations. They were also deployed to engage small bands of renegades and outlaws, such as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
